newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK growth seen at 6-7 pct before century end - Tsang.
newsitem.headline: HK growth seen at 6-7 pct before century end - Tsang.

text.p: Hong Kong's Financial Secretary Donald Tsang said on Wednesday that real annual growth in the territory could hit between six and seven percent before the end of this century.

"I can see our real annual growth bursting through the current five percent level and reach six to seven percent before this century runs out," Tsang said in an address to the Trade Development Council.
